result.result: The requested URL (https://scrapeme.live/shop) is consistently unreachable. Multiple attempts using different approaches (direct navigation, base URL, reconfiguring the browser, waiting) all resulted in connection errors (ERR_TIMED_OUT and ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED). While search results confirm that scrapeme.live exists as a WordPress/WooCommerce demo site, the page is currently unavailable from the current connection, making it impossible to extract the requested information about fees, shipping charges, countdown timers, or limited stock messages.
